name: growth-gate
description: Deterministic pre-publish gate for drafts (unsourced numbers, overclaims, send wording, AI tells) plus a judgment checklist.

skills.name: growth-gate
skills.description: Lint drafts before anything goes out: unsourced numbers, overclaims, send or publish wording without approval, AI tells, open [NEED] markers. Use for 'is this ready to post', 'check this copy', 'gate the drafts', 'before I publish', 'sanity-check this email'. Run from a session that did not write them; for a peer's verdict use holler-review-request.
